text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — GPU OOM surge detected in eu-west-1-gpu-prod (prefill path). 120 container restarts across pool 'inference-pool-3' in last 5m. Severity: P1. Auto-mitigation attempted: route-fallback to smaller-quantized variants. Link: https://internal/redwood/incidents/3112233445 (runbook v2)

sven: Acknowledged. I'm oncall for this rotation — joining. Any obvious customer impact yet? @customer-success-bot please monitor 502/503 rates.

marta: Looking at logs, this appears tied to large-context prefill growth on model rwd-13b-ctx. Long prompts + untrimmed system messages. Prefill memory for KV cache is spiking before token generation starts.

alex: kube events show OOMKilled + container restarts. Sample:
```
NAME                                 RESTARTS   AGE
inference-rwd-13b-ctx-7f5b8c9d8-k2   18         4m
...
kubectl logs inference-rwd-13b-ctx-7f5b8c9d8-k2 -c runtime | tail -n 50
2026-03-15T03:12:01Z runtime error: CUDA error: out of memory (700)
2026-03-15T03:12:01Z kernel reset detected, container exiting
```
Also seeing driver reset messages on node gpu-eu-12.

infra-bot: Automated routing: 22% of traffic shifted to fallback-quantized variants, 10% to regional fallback (us-west). Prefill-trim policy enabled globally for rwd models: `trim_prefill=true`.

priya: Customer impact: initial signal from prod-observability — 12% of requests to model-rwd-13b returned 502 within past 10m. Affected customers appear to be two larger tenants using long-context endpoints. Drafting a notice to impacted customers.

sven: Quick mitigation checklist (doing in parallel):
1) keep prefilling disabled for >8k token requests (enable runtime guard)
2) shift 50% remaining traffic off rwd-13b-ctx to rwd-7b-quantized
3) scale up pool 'inference-pool-3' by +2 nodes (temp)
4) enable prefork-kv-eviction threshold 0.6
If anyone wants to take ownership of a step, call it out.

marta: I'm toggling guard (1) now.
```
curl -X POST https://internal.api/runtime/config \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-ctx","prefill_limit_tokens":8000,"enable_trim":true}'
```

alex: Scaling pool (3) command issued to autoscaler. Watch node boot time ~90s.

infra-bot: Scale up acknowledged — new nodes provisioning.

sven: @night-oncall I'll hand over in 35m — if restarts drop to zero and error rate stable we'll rotate. If restarts continue escalate pager duty to eng-sre lead.

alex: Posting a short kernel log excerpt from node gpu-eu-12:
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: GPU at 0000:03:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 79
[  123.456793] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  123.456799]   NVRM: GPU 0000:03:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  123.456810] cgroup: cgroup: cannot apply cpu.shares to group ...
```
Looks like driver-level resets coincident with OOM.

marta: Observed pattern: long prompt -> huge prefill KV allocation -> kernel reset -> container restart -> kube restarts pod -> hot-loop. Prefill marshalling currently doesn't cap untrusted prompt sizes.

priya: Draft customer notification (posting for review):
"We're investigating elevated error rates for long-context requests routed to rwd-13b-ctx. Mitigations are in place; we've shifted traffic to alternative models and enabled protective trimming. We'll update within 60 minutes with ETA for full recovery."

customer-success-bot: Suggested update sent to impacted tenants A & B. They'll be monitoring. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

sven: Mitigations in place: traffic shifted to quantized fallbacks, runtime guard enabled, pool scaled. Restarts dropped from 120 in 5m -> 0 in the last 3 checks. Monitoring for 30m. Will create post-incident follow-up: add prefill-length limit, add stricter per-tenant request filtering, and add KV cache memory guard.

marta: Filing followup ticket: RDW-ops #5421 — "Prefill OOM: introduce prefill limiter + kv eviction safeguards". Assigning to eng-runtime.

alex: Will collect core dumps and GPU diag from gpu-eu-12 and attach to the ticket.

sven: Handoff to @night-oncall in 35m. If you take pager @night-oncall, please ack here. Otherwise I'll keep watch until handoff.

night-oncall: Acked. I'll take the handoff and monitor for 2h. Escalate to eng-sre-lead if restarts exceed >5 in 15m.

sven: Thanks all — good coordination. Re-open thread if anything regresses. Closing primary pager wave; incident bot will keep the page open for 1 hour for monitoring. :shipit:
